reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that notifies users when an agent task finishes, with configurable chimes, volume, mute, and local custom-audio management.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中于智能体任务完成时播放可配置提示音，并支持音量、静音和本地自定义音频管理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that plays configurable chimes when an agent task finishes, with volume, mute, and local custom-audio management.

capabilities: Monitors the current session agent state for task completion
Uploads, stores, previews, and deletes local audio files
Persists plugin settings through local host routes
